rules.statement: A mortgagee cannot bring a second hypothecary action for the same matter where a previous action has been dismissed, and such actions are barred by sections 406(2) and 408 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, whether one regards the dismissal of the previous action brought by the appellant as a withdrawal of it under section 408 or an adjustment under section 408, the effect of the decree passed in that action is to preclude the appellant from bringing the same action again, notwithstanding the provisions of section 7 (1) of the Mortgage Act."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 406(2) and 408 of the Civil Procedure Code
